title: Main.java — demoIterator() (Iterator)
text:
=================================================
  Pattern 7: Iterator
=================================================
VillainWave hides its storage -- the client only ever calls add() and
walks it with a for-each loop, never touching the underlying List.

Walking the wave with a plain for-each loop:
  -> Slime  HP 40
  -> Goblin  HP 55
  -> Ogre  HP 70
